name: Sheru Bhai AI
tagline: Turn your photo into a Sheru Bhai AI lion video
description: Sheru Bhai AI (sheru-bhai.com) turns one photo into a short cinematic video with Sheru, the charismatic lion behind the viral Sheru Bhai trend. Choose a scene template such as street walk, island sunset, cafe booth, in class, pink BMW or Rolls-Royce entry, upload a clear front-facing photo, and get a vertical 9:16 HD video ready for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. You can also browse the free Sheru Bhai photo and GIF scene galleries for ideas. Pay-as-you-go credit packs start at $4.89 (100 credits per video) with no subscription, and finished videos stay in My Video for 30 days.
